verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents its own Web API, and its pricing page lists an audit log with API access, so some programmatic access exists. Nothing in the pack shows the API matches the UI's scope, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: evidence of API parity with UI features (remote sessions, device management, DEX, AI features), a machine-readable API spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation of API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
